Maria Pemberton Joins the Video Team

  • Post author By Mariya.Greeley
  • Post date July 24, 2026

Maria, a not-so-secret weapon for social video who has helped Globe stories reach millions, steps into a full-time role as Multimedia Producer.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:34
Instaread

I’m excited to officially welcome Maria Pemberton to the video team as our newest Multimedia Producer.

Many of you already know Maria from her time as a Globe video co-op. Since joining us full-time, she’s quietly become one of the newsroom’s not-so-secret weapons for social video. If you’ve watched one of Emily Sweeney’s videos over the past few months, chances are you’ve already seen Maria’s work. She’s an essential creative partner — shooting, editing, producing, and helping shape the storytelling behind videos that have reached millions of viewers.

Maria comes to us from Boston University (an early achiever who won’t graduate until 2027). A Pennsylvania native, Maria now lives in Brookline, where she’s always looking for restaurant recommendations, especially the spots people are gatekeeping.

She has also survived countless freezing New England shoots with the help of her trusty “emotional support puffer.” And no pitch is too out-of-the-box for her, she’s excited to hear all the wild, ambitious, and slightly crazy ideas you have to offer.

In her new role, Maria will continue collaborating with Emily while expanding her work across the newsroom, producing social-first journalism and helping us tell more stories on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and beyond. Maria’s skill in this department will help expand our growing presence on these critical channels and introduce a new generation of users to the Globe. 

We’re thrilled she’s officially part of the team.

—Anush Elbakyan, Director of Video/Senior Editor

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Functional Cookies

Targeting Cookies
